mapper.select: SELECT id, flow_no, agent_id, user_id, related_agent_id, related_user_id, asset_code, asset_name, change_type, amount, balance_after, biz_type, biz_id, remark, create_time FROM dms_member_asset_flow WHERE flow_no = #{flowNo}

SELECT f.id, f.flow_no AS flowNo, f.agent_id AS agentId, f.user_id AS userId, m.id AS memberId, COALESCE(NULLIF(m.nickname, ''), NULLIF(m.username, ''), m.phone) AS memberName, m.username AS memberUsername, m.phone AS memberPhone, f.related_agent_id AS relatedAgentId, f.related_user_id AS relatedUserId, f.change_type AS changeType, f.amount, f.balance_after AS balanceAfter, f.biz_type AS bizType, f.biz_id AS bizId, f.remark, f.create_time AS createTime FROM dms_member_asset_flow f LEFT JOIN dms_shop_member m ON m.user_id = f.user_id WHERE f.asset_code = 'CASH_BONUS'
AND (f.flow_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND f.change_type IN (1, 4)
AND f.change_type IN (2, 3, 5)
AND f.biz_type LIKE '%MANUAL_MEMBER_ADJUST'
AND f.biz_type = 'COMMISSION_SETTLE'
AND f.biz_type = 'MEMBER_BALANCE_TRANSFER'
AND f.biz_type = 'ORDER_BALANCE_PAYMENT'
AND f.biz_type IN ('BALANCE_PAYMENT_REFUND', 'WITHDRAW_REJECT_REFUND')
AND f.biz_type = 'WITHDRAW_APPLY'
AND f.biz_type = 'COMMISSION_CLAWBACK'
AND f.biz_type IN ('ORDER_BALANCE_ALLOCATION', 'ORDER_BALANCE_ALLOCATION_REFUND')
AND f.create_time >= #{startTime}
AND f.create_time <= #{endTime}
ORDER BY f.create_time DESC, f.id DESC

SELECT id, flow_no, agent_id, user_id, related_agent_id, related_user_id, asset_code, asset_name, change_type, amount, balance_after, biz_type, biz_id, remark, create_time FROM dms_member_asset_flow WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} AND biz_type = 'COMMISSION_SETTLE' AND biz_id = CAST(#{commissionRecordId} AS CHAR) AND change_type = 1 ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dms_member_asset_flow (flow_no, agent_id, user_id, related_agent_id, related_user_id, asset_code, asset_name, change_type, amount, balance_after, biz_type, biz_id, remark) VALUES (#{flowNo}, #{agentId}, #{userId}, #{relatedAgentId}, #{relatedUserId}, #{assetCode}, #{assetName}, #{changeType}, #{amount}, #{balanceAfter}, #{bizType}, #{bizId}, #{remark})
